QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_27

question.text: The exit process for dissenting investors (change of Sponsor/IM or material PPM change) must be completed within:

answer.text: 1 month from the expiry of the dissent offer period
2 months from the expiry of the dissent offer period
3 months from the expiry of the dissent offer period
6 months from the expiry of the dissent offer period

explanation.text: The Logic: The entire dissenting-investor exit process must be completed within 3 MONTHS from the date of expiry of the offer for dissent. The expenses are borne by the Manager/Sponsor/proposed new Manager or Sponsor — NOT charged to unit holders. The Trap: 1/2/6 month windows are common in other SEBI regimes (e.g., buybacks) — not this one. The dissent-offer period itself is 'not less than one month'; the 3-month clock starts AFTER dissent period closes. Note: The workbook fixes the 3-month completion rule and the cost-bearer; specific escrow and payment-mechanics process advice is not part of the syllabus.
